events.verdict: James (LAL) does not take more than two steps after his gather.
Carter (ATL) brings one hand to the opposite side of Hart's (LAL) body but immediately removes it.
Young (ATL) makes incidental foot to foot contact with James (LAL).
Spellman (ATL) makes contact with Hart's (LAL) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
LAR shows that Young (ATL) throws the ball off James's (LAL) foot, which remains on the floor.
Kuzma (LAL) briefly grasps Carter's (ATL) jersey and does not affect his FOM.
Hart (LAL) jumps to pass and releases the ball prior to landing.
All technical fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
Kuzma (LAL) brings one hand to the near side of Carter's (ATL) body but slides it off.
[Observable in enhanced video] James (LAL) splits his feet at the start of the dribble.
Carter (ATL) initiates contact with James (LAL) but does not affect his ability to maintain his position.
Carter (ATL) makes contact with James's (LAL) arm at the start of his drive but does not affect his SQBR.
Spellman (ATL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Spellman (ATL) faces up and dislodges Chandler (LAL) during the rebound.
Carter (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position against James (LAL) during his drive.
Chandler (LAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Carter (ATL) steps into Hart's (LAL) path and initiates foot to foot contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
The Lakers fail to attempt a shot that touches the rim prior to the 24 second shot clock expiring.
Spellman (ATL) makes contact with James's (LAL) body and affects his driving shot attempt.
Chandler (LAL) clamps Len's (ATL) arm during the rebound.
Prince (ATL) clamps Chandler's (LAL) arm during the rebound.
Spellman (ATL) initiates contact with Kuzma (LAL) but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Carter (ATL) cleanly strips the ball from Kuzma (LAL).
Carter (ATL) makes incidental contact with Kuzma's (LAL) body after the release of his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Spellman (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position on James's (LAL) shot.

After the made dunk shot, James (LAL) remains on the rim after the timeout is called and players have cleared the area under the rim. The ball is dead and he is not taunting opponents or delaying the game.
Chandler (LAL) makes contact with the ball prior to it reaching the apex.
